<!-- =========================================================
     PipeLine Pros Plumbing · DEMO WEBSITE by Radiance Tech (Plumbing, Phoenix, AZ)
     Fictional business for portfolio use. Paste this whole file into one GHL Custom HTML element.
     RE-THEME: edit the token block below.

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Bungee&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<div class="dm-pipeli dark hdk" data-dm="dm-pipeli" id="dm-pipeli-top">
<style>
.dm-pipeli{
  /* ---------- THEME TOKENS (edit only this block to re-theme) ---------- */
  --d-bg:#0A1F3D; --d-bg2:#0D2749; --d-surf:#123059;
  --d-ink:#FFFFFF; --d-ink-rgb:255,255,255; --d-bg-rgb:10,31,61;
  --d-acc:#1EA7FF; --d-acc-rgb:30,167,255; --d-on:#FFFFFF;
  --d-muted:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.68); --d-line:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.12); --d-line2:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.22);
  --d-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  --d-disp:"Bricolage Grotesque","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --d-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --d-magic:"Bungee",var(--d-disp);   /* niche accent font for highlighted words */
  --d-magic-style:normal; --d-magic-w:400; --d-magic-size:.8em; --d-magic-ls:0;
  --d-r:14px; --d-rbtn:999px; --d-rimg:20px;
  --d-ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
}

.dm-pipeli,.dm-pipeli *,.dm-pipeli *::before,.dm-pipeli *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
.dm-pipeli{position:relative;font-family:var(--d-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--d-ink);background:var(--d-bg);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
.dm-pipeli a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.dm-pipeli ul,.dm-pipeli ol{list-style:none}.dm-pipeli img{display:block;max-width:100%}.dm-pipeli svg{flex:none;display:block}
.dm-pipeli button,.dm-pipeli input,.dm-pipeli select{font:inherit;color:inherit}.dm-pipeli button{background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.dm-pipeli :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--d-acc);outline-offset:3px}
.dm-pipeli h1,.dm-pipeli h2,.dm-pipeli h3,.dm-pipeli h4{font-family:var(--d-disp);color:var(--d-ink);font-weight:800;line-height:1.05}
.dm-pipeli .w{width:100%;max-width:1240px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:20px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .w{padding-inline:40px}}
.dm-pipeli em{font-style:normal;color:var(--d-acc)}
/* demo ribbon */
.dm-pipeli .demo{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px 14px;padding:9px 16px;background:var(--d-acc);background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-acc) 90%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-acc) 84%,#fff) 82%,transparent));backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--d-on);font-size:13px;text-align:center;line-height:1.35}
.dm-pipeli .demo b{font-weight:700}.dm-pipeli .demo i{font-style:normal}@media(max-width:559px){.dm-pipeli .demo .lg{display:none}.dm-pipeli .demo{flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:10px;font-size:12.5px}}.dm-pipeli .demo u{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--d-on) 16%,transparent)}.dm-pipeli .demo u svg{width:14px;height:14px}
/* header */
.dm-pipeli .tp{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50}
.dm-pipeli .hd{position:relative;z-index:50;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.1);transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.dm-pipeli.hdk .hd:not(.fx){color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}.dm-pipeli.hdk .hd:not(.fx) .lt b{color:#fff}.dm-pipeli.hdk .hd:not(.fx) .lt small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.dm-pipeli .hd.fx{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.9);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-color:var(--d-line);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);animation:dm-pipeli-drop .45s var(--d-ease)}
@keyframes dm-pipeli-drop{from{transform:translateY(-100%)}}
.dm-pipeli .hero{padding-top:var(--tph,112px)}.dm-pipeli .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:calc(var(--tph,112px) + 90px);z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.9),rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.55) 55%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),0))}.dm-pipeli section[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}
.dm-pipeli .hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;height:72px}
.dm-pipeli .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.dm-pipeli .lm{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 4px);background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-pipeli .lm svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.dm-pipeli .lt{display:grid;line-height:1}.dm-pipeli .lt b{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.dm-pipeli .lt small{margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .nl{display:none;gap:30px;font-weight:500;font-size:15px}.dm-pipeli .nl a{opacity:.85;transition:opacity .2s}.dm-pipeli .nl a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-pipeli .hr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.dm-pipeli .ph{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}.dm-pipeli .ph svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .ph span{display:none}
@media(min-width:960px){.dm-pipeli .nl{display:flex}.dm-pipeli .ph span{display:inline}}
@media(max-width:420px){.dm-pipeli .hd .btn--sm{padding:0 14px}}
/* buttons */
.dm-pipeli .btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:54px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:var(--d-rbtn);font-weight:700;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:transform .3s var(--d-ease),box-shadow .3s,background .2s,border-color .2s}
.dm-pipeli .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;transition:transform .3s var(--d-ease)}.dm-pipeli .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.dm-pipeli .btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.dm-pipeli .btn--acc{background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.85)}
.dm-pipeli .btn--ghost{border-color:var(--d-line2);color:var(--d-ink)}.dm-pipeli .btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--d-ink)}.dm-pipeli .btn--ghost svg{color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .btn--ghost:hover svg{transform:none}
.dm-pipeli .btn--on{background:var(--d-on);color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-pipeli .btn--sm{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;font-size:14.5px}.dm-pipeli .btn--full{width:100%}
.dm-pipeli .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-pipeli .ctas .btn{width:100%}}
/* type */
.dm-pipeli h1{font-weight:inherit;font-size:clamp(40px,5.4vw,74px);letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1}
.dm-pipeli h1 .l{display:block}
.dm-pipeli .lede{margin-top:22px;max-width:56ch;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,19.5px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .kick{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-pipeli .kick::before{content:"";width:24px;height:2px;background:currentColor}
.dm-pipeli .h2{margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,58px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.04;text-wrap:balance}
.dm-pipeli .lead{margin-top:16px;max-width:60ch;font-size:17.5px;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .head{max-width:760px;margin-bottom:48px}.dm-pipeli .head.c{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}.dm-pipeli .head.c .lead{margin-inline:auto}
.dm-pipeli .stars{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;color:#FFB400}.dm-pipeli .stars svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.dm-pipeli .rate{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 14px 7px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(var(--d-ink-rgb),.07);border:1px solid var(--d-line);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:22px}
.dm-pipeli .rate b{font-weight:800}.dm-pipeli .rate .lp svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--d-acc)}
.dm-pipeli .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;margin-top:26px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
.dm-pipeli .chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.dm-pipeli .chips svg{width:18px;height:18px;padding:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}
/* cards */
.dm-pipeli .card{position:relative;background:var(--d-surf);border:1.5px solid var(--d-line);border-radius:var(--d-r);box-shadow:var(--d-shadow)}
/* hero A: photo + form */
.dm-pipeli .hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.dm-pipeli .hbg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:#111 center/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.04);animation:dm-pipeli-zoom 18s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes dm-pipeli-zoom{to{transform:scale(1)}}
.dm-pipeli .hsh{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.96) 0%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.86) 42%,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.35) 100%)}
.dm-pipeli .hA .hgrid{display:grid;gap:36px;align-items:center;padding-block:56px 64px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .hA .hgrid{grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:56px;padding-block:84px 96px;min-height:min(760px,calc(100svh - 110px))}}
.dm-pipeli .hA h1,.dm-pipeli .hC h1{color:#fff}.dm-pipeli .hA .lede,.dm-pipeli .hC .lede{color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}.dm-pipeli .hA .rate,.dm-pipeli .hC .rate{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff}
.dm-pipeli .hA .btn--ghost,.dm-pipeli .hC .btn--ghost{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}.dm-pipeli .hA .chips,.dm-pipeli .hC .chips{color:#fff}
.dm-pipeli.light .hsh{background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(10,14,22,.9) 0%,rgba(10,14,22,.7) 45%,rgba(10,14,22,.2) 100%)}
/* quote form */
.dm-pipeli .qcard{padding:26px 22px}
@media(min-width:560px){.dm-pipeli .qcard{padding:30px 28px}}
.dm-pipeli .hA .qcard{border-top:4px solid var(--d-acc)}
.dm-pipeli .qf{display:grid;gap:12px}
.dm-pipeli .qt{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:24px;line-height:1.1}.dm-pipeli .qs{margin-top:-6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .row2{display:grid;gap:12px}@media(min-width:420px){.dm-pipeli .row2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.dm-pipeli .qf label{display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .qf input,.dm-pipeli .qf select{width:100%;height:52px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.5 + 6px);border:1.5px solid var(--d-line2);background:var(--d-bg);color:var(--d-ink);font-size:16px;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.dm-pipeli .qf select{background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,currentColor 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,currentColor 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 23px,calc(100% - 15px) 23px;background-size:5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.dm-pipeli .qf input:focus,.dm-pipeli .qf select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--d-acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.18)}
.dm-pipeli .qf input.bad{border-color:#E5484D}
.dm-pipeli .qf .btn{margin-top:4px}
.dm-pipeli .fine{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--d-muted)}.dm-pipeli .fine svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.dm-pipeli .done{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center;padding:20px 0}.dm-pipeli .done[hidden]{display:none}
.dm-pipeli .ok{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-pipeli .ok svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.dm-pipeli .done b{font-family:var(--d-disp);font-size:22px}.dm-pipeli .done p{color:var(--d-muted);font-size:14.5px}
/* hero B: split + arch photo */
.dm-pipeli .hB{background:radial-gradient(60% 70% at 85% 30%,rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14),transparent 70%),var(--d-bg)}
.dm-pipeli .hB .hgrid{display:grid;gap:44px;align-items:center;padding-block:48px 72px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .hB .hgrid{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:64px;padding-block:72px 96px;min-height:min(740px,calc(100svh - 110px))}}
.dm-pipeli .hart{position:relative}
.dm-pipeli .arch{overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/4.4;border-radius:min(var(--d-rimg),40px);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(16,24,40,.45)}
.dm-pipeli .arch img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.dm-pipeli .float{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--d-surf);border:1px solid var(--d-line);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -20px rgba(16,24,40,.35);font-size:14px}
.dm-pipeli .float b{display:block;font-size:14.5px}.dm-pipeli .float small{display:block;color:var(--d-muted);font-size:12.5px}
.dm-pipeli .float .ic{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14);color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .float .ic svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.dm-pipeli .f1{left:-14px;bottom:28px}.dm-pipeli .f2{right:-10px;top:24px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-pipeli .f1{left:10px;bottom:14px}.dm-pipeli .f2{right:10px;top:12px}}
/* hero C: centered big */
.dm-pipeli .hC{text-align:center}
.dm-pipeli .hC .hsh{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.72),rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.82) 55%,var(--d-bg))}
.dm-pipeli.light .hC .hsh{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,14,22,.65),rgba(10,14,22,.82))}
.dm-pipeli .hc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding-block:88px 56px}
@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .hc{padding-block:120px 72px;min-height:min(640px,calc(100svh - 230px));justify-content:center}}
.dm-pipeli .hC h1{max-width:18ch;font-size:clamp(42px,6.2vw,90px)}.dm-pipeli .hC .lede{margin-inline:auto}.dm-pipeli .hC .ctas,.dm-pipeli .hC .chips{justify-content:center}
.dm-pipeli .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:24px}
.dm-pipeli .pill i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.3)}
.dm-pipeli .hstrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;margin-bottom:40px;border-radius:var(--d-r);overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:0}
@media(min-width:900px){.dm-pipeli .hstrip{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-bottom:56px}}
.dm-pipeli .hstrip>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0 12px;align-items:center;padding:18px 18px;background:rgba(var(--d-bg-rgb),.82);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);text-align:left;color:#fff}
.dm-pipeli .hstrip svg{grid-row:span 2;width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .hstrip b{font-size:15px}.dm-pipeli .hstrip span{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.dm-pipeli .hC .hstrip{max-width:calc(1240px - 80px);width:calc(100% - 40px)}
/* trust row */
.dm-pipeli .trust{background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}
.dm-pipeli .tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px 20px;padding-block:18px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px}
@media(min-width:900px){.dm-pipeli .tr{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);justify-content:space-between}}
.dm-pipeli .tr div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.dm-pipeli .tr svg{width:22px;height:22px}
/* sections */
.dm-pipeli .sec{padding-block:84px}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .sec{padding-block:120px}}
.dm-pipeli .sec.alt{background:var(--d-bg2)}
.dm-pipeli .sg{display:grid;gap:16px}@media(min-width:640px){.dm-pipeli .sg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .sg{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}}
.dm-pipeli .sv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:28px 26px;transition:transform .5s var(--d-ease),border-color .3s}
.dm-pipeli .sv:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.6)}
.dm-pipeli .ib{display:grid;place-items:center;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 4px);background:rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.14);color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .ib svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.dm-pipeli .sv h3{margin-top:20px;font-size:23px}.dm-pipeli .sv p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--d-muted);font-size:15.5px}
.dm-pipeli .more{margin-top:auto;padding-top:18px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--d-acc)}.dm-pipeli .more svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .3s}.dm-pipeli .sv:hover .more svg{transform:translateX(4px)}
.dm-pipeli .split{display:grid;gap:44px;align-items:center}@media(min-width:1024px){.dm-pipeli .split{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:72px}}
.dm-pipeli .split.top{align-items:start}
.dm-pipeli .pic{position:relative}.dm-pipeli .pic img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/4.3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--d-rimg)}
.dm-pipeli .badge{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:calc(var(--d-r)*.6 + 6px);background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.dm-pipeli .badge b{display:block;font-family:var(--d-disp);font-size:20px;line-height:1.1}.dm-pipeli .badge span{font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.dm-pipeli .why{display:grid;gap:18px;margin-top:28px}.dm-pipeli .why li{display:flex;gap:14px}
.dm-pipeli .ck{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}.dm-pipeli .ck svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.dm-pipeli .why b{font-size:17px}.dm-pipeli .why p{color:var(--d-muted);font-size:15.5px}
.dm-pipeli .offer{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--d-acc),rgba(var(--d-acc-rgb),.82));color:var(--d-on)}
.dm-pipeli .ob{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px 32px;padding-block:34px}
.dm-pipeli .ob .tag{display:inline-block;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.14);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.dm-pipeli .ob p{margin-top:10px;font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px);line-height:1.15;max-width:30ch}
@media(max-width:559px){.dm-pipeli .ob .btn{width:100%}}
.dm-pipeli .steps{display:grid;gap:16px}@media(min-width:900px){.dm-pipeli .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}}
.dm-pipeli .st{padding:30px 26px}.dm-pipeli .st .n{display:grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on);font-family:var(--d-disp);font-weight:800;font-size:20px}
.dm-pipeli .st h3{margin-top:18px;font-size:22px}.dm-pipeli .st p{margin-top:6px;color:var(--d-muted)}
.dm-pipeli .gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}

.dm-pipeli .m a.dir{background:var(--d-acc);color:var(--d-on)}

@keyframes dm-pipeli-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.92)}}

/* magic accent font + hand-drawn underline + highlighter */

  var RULES=[['site',['website','web site','site like','this site','radiance','who built','who made','built this','made this','web design','want one like','same site','page like']],

  /* Voice replies: browser speech (no paid service). Voice matches the support person: VG f = female, m = male */
  var VG='m',SS=window.speechSynthesis,VO=null,VON=!!SS,vt=root.querySelector('[data-vt]');
  var FEM=/female|woman|samantha|victoria|karen|moira|tessa|fiona|zira|aria|jenny|ava|allison|susan|serena|libby|sonia|natasha|emma|joanna|salli|kendra|kimberly|ivy|michelle|sara|nicky|google us english/i;
